answer: The vine counter is kept in vault and marble reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 37 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Someone therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 37 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4672 identities would post 618 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
